test_objective: Check that you can query one entity via POST Interaction based on id

test_cases.name: 019_02_01 Query one entity via POST Interaction based on id
test_cases.doc: Check that you can query one entity via POST Interaction based on id
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entityOperations/query'
        method set to 'POST'
        Get Entities Via POST Request: and
    Query Parameter: entity_ids set to '${first_entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: entity_types set to 'https://ngsi-ld-test-suite/context#Building' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/json' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to 'application/json'
}
